data_location_note: The first replay build initially downloaded about 20 MiB of Cargo registry data under /root/.cargo/registry. It was moved to /data/cargo/registry and the original path replaced with a symlink. Subsequent builds use CARGO_HOME=/data/cargo. All target directories, experiment inputs, fixtures, cache/object/Redis data and results are on /data. OS-managed service unit files, journal/control runtime files are exceptions; unattended upgrades independently wrote OS files.
